title: agent-kit's data in an extension's plugin.json
description: What goes under metadata["agent-kit"] in a Claude Code plugin's .claude-plugin/plugin.json, for agent-kit's gates, chats and catalog. Claude Code doesn't read metadata. Every field is optional.

kit.description: The agent-kit versions it works with: comparators separated by spaces, all of which must hold (">=0.22.0", ">=0.22.0 <0.24.0").

provides.description: Capabilities it lets the agent use.

requires.description: Capabilities another enabled extension must provide.

needs.description: Programs it needs on the computer's PATH.

readOnlyTools.description: Its tools that only read (short names): plan mode lets them through. Without it, plan mode asks its servers (readOnlyHint).

labels.description: How the chat shows each tool (short name), per language (en, es, fr, de): {field} takes the call's input.

phrase.description: How it counts in a folded summary: once, and {n} times.

help.description: What it says about itself in a session, for the agent to tell the person.

catalog.description: How a catalog shows it: images inside its folder (SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP).
